result.summary: The environment is a wide urban commercial corridor with continuous sidewalks but lacks significant pedestrian protection. While signalized intersections are present, the roadway width and lack of physical buffers or high-visibility crossing markings create a vehicle-centric atmosphere.

hazards.name: Wide Roadway
hazards.description: The wide, multi-lane roadway encourages higher vehicle speeds and increases the exposure time for pedestrians crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Center roadway extending toward the horizon

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A large utility or storage box on the right sidewalk narrows the effective walking path for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of Crossing Markings
hazards.description: The signalized intersection ahead lacks visible high-visibility crosswalk markings, reducing driver awareness of pedestrian paths.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings at the intersection to improve visibility and driver compliance.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the intersection to shorten crossing distances and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Add a line of street trees or planters to provide a vertical buffer between the sidewalk and moving traffic.

result.summary: The image shows a commercial street frontage with a continuous paved sidewalk in front of retail stores. The pedestrian environment is functional but cluttered with utility structures and street furniture, while parked vehicles create a visual barrier between the walkway and the roadway.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A large utility structure and trash bin significantly narrow the usable width of the sidewalk.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A large SUV parked at the curb blocks sightlines between the sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to increase pedestrian visibility and reduce the crossing distance at intersections.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Management
interventions.description: Relocate utility boxes and street furniture to a designated furniture zone to maintain a clear walking path.

result.summary: This commercial street features continuous sidewalks on both sides, but lacks any visible marked pedestrian crossings or traffic calming measures. Pedestrian safety is compromised by significant visual obstructions created by continuous on-street parallel parking, which limits sightlines between drivers and people attempting to cross.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Continuous parallel parking on both sides of the street creates a visual barrier, making it difficult for drivers to see pedestrians stepping off the curb.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs throughout the visible street segment.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: The absence of marked crosswalks in this commercial area forces pedestrians to cross the two-lane roadway without designated priority or visibility enhancements.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire roadway width in the foreground and mid-ground.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at potential crossing points to increase pedestrian visibility, reduce crossing distance, and prevent parking too close to intersections or crossings.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Implement high-visibility (continental or ladder) crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian paths and alert motorists to the presence of people crossing.

result.summary: The image depicts an urban mid-block environment with a continuous sidewalk and mixed-use buildings. Pedestrian safety is compromised by the lack of marked crossings and significant visual obstructions from a large school bus and parked vehicles.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossing
hazards.description: No designated crossing points are visible for pedestrians wishing to cross the street.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction
hazards.description: The large school bus and parked cars block sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and moving traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and left side of the roadway

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility paint to designate a safe crossing point.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at potential crossing points to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Speed Management
interventions.description: Implement traffic calming measures like speed humps to reduce vehicle speeds in this mixed-use area.
